english.title: Cause vehicle to remain stationary during darkness without lights
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to allow to remain at rest on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time between sunset and sunrise when **(..SPECIFY FRONT/REAR POSITION, REAR REGISTRATION PLATE, SIDE/END-OUTLINE MARKER LAMP(S)..) required to be fitted by the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989

(A)_[was]_
(B)_[were]_

not kept lit and unobscured .
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 24(1)(b) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
